items: ⅓ coconut flour (if needed, and especially for a sweet pie, blend coconut as a substitute)
6 slices thick-cut bacon, cut in pieces
8 ounces chopped fresh spinach (or if using frozen, thaw and squeeze to remove moisture)

steps.title: Mix the crust
steps.body: Preheat oven to 400°F, and mix together in a bowl: **½ cup butter**, melted, **1½ cups almond flour**, **⅓ coconut flour** (if needed, and especially for a sweet pie, blend coconut as a substitute), **½ tsp salt** and **1 beaten egg**.

steps.title: Par-bake the crust
steps.body: Press into pie tin, prick with fork, and par-bake until golden, 10–15 minutes. Then remove and reduce oven heat to 350°F.

steps.title: Fry the bacon
steps.body: In a large frying pan, chop and fry until crispy: **6 slices thick-cut bacon**, cut in pieces.

steps.title: Soften the onion
steps.body: Remove bacon, drain some fat, and sauté until soft: **1 medium onion**.

steps.title: Wilt the spinach
steps.body: Add and cook until wilted: **8 ounces chopped fresh spinach** (or if using frozen, thaw and squeeze to remove moisture).

steps.title: Fill the crust
steps.body: Pour this mixture into the par-baked pie shell.

steps.title: Whisk the custard
steps.body: In a bowl, whisk together: **½ cup heavy whipping cream**, **4 eggs**, **¼ tsp salt** and **⅙ tsp pepper**. Mix into bowl: **1 cup cheese of choice**, grated.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Pour this mixture over the bacon/spinach/onion, and bake for 45 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Serve with fresh tomatoes, basil, aioli, etc. as desired.
